group_difference: use_context
Discover a non-obvious difference in how use context changes reported product performance; distinguish context from overall satisfaction.
expectation_gaps
Discover where expectations and reported experience diverge differently across defensible populations; explain the practical consequence.
failure_concentration
Find a specific failure pattern whose concentration across populations is obscured by overall review volume.
adaptation
Discover a difference in consumer adaptation or workarounds and examine whether apparent success masks recurring limitations.
durability_tradeoffs
Find a population-dependent tradeoff between immediate experience and continued usefulness without equating star ratings with the mechanism.
temporal_change: experience_shift
Discover a meaningful shift in the substance of reported experiences and locate a defensible time boundary; test a composition explanation.
emerging_friction
Find an emerging or receding usage friction, distinguishing a change in its prevalence from changes in review volume.
expectation_evolution
Investigate how an observable expectation-experience mismatch changes over time; explain alternative reasons for the apparent shift.
persistence
Discover a change in a recurring product limitation and assess whether it is broad or driven by a concentrated product mix.
compound_association: tradeoff_coupling
Discover a useful association between two distinct reported experiences that reveals a practical product tradeoff.
context_response
Find a context-response relationship in the text and distinguish it from two descriptions of the same event.
failure_recovery
Discover a relationship between an observed difficulty and a distinct response or recovery experience; inspect discordant cases.
expectation_behavior
Find a nontrivial link between an observable expectation and a subsequent reported behavior without treating co-occurrence as causation.

group_difference: workflow_disruption
Discover how a specific workflow disruption differs across defensible user or application populations.
access_barriers
Find a non-obvious disparity in a concrete barrier to successful use; distinguish the barrier from generic dissatisfaction.
adaptation_cost
Discover a difference in workarounds or adaptation burdens and investigate whether application mix explains it.
promise_experience
Find where promised or expected utility diverges from reported practical utility across populations.
failure_impact
Discover a difference in the consequences of a recurring failure pattern, not merely which population gives lower ratings.
temporal_change: workflow_evolution
Discover a time-local change in workflow experience; choose and justify the boundary and investigate application composition.
regression_pattern
Find a substantive emerging or receding failure pattern without assuming any release date or assigning an unsupported cause.
utility_shift
Discover a change in how people describe realized utility, separating prevalence from changing document volume.
recovery_shift
Investigate a temporal change in reported recovery or adaptation; establish the scope of the observed change.
compound_association: friction_response
Discover a relationship between a concrete usage friction and a distinct user response; analyze counterexamples.
utility_tradeoff
Find two distinct experiences whose association reveals a non-obvious utility tradeoff.
context_failure
Discover an association between a stated usage context and a specific failure or success experience.
recovery_limit
Find a relationship between attempted recovery and a separately defined limitation; avoid defining one condition by the other.

group_difference: resolution_burden
Discover how a specific burden in pursuing resolution differs across defensible complaint populations.
process_breakdown
Find a disparity in an observable procedural breakdown; distinguish process from generic negative sentiment.
downstream_impact
Discover a population-dependent difference in a concrete downstream consequence described in narratives.
recurrence
Find where a recurring problem differs across populations and examine whether reporting composition explains the contrast.
information_asymmetry
Discover a difference in an observable information or communication barrier and explain its practical implications.
temporal_change: process_shift
Discover a shift in an observable complaint-handling experience, selecting a defensible time boundary without assuming policy causation.
burden_shift
Find an emerging or declining resolution burden and assess whether company composition explains the trend.
impact_shift
Discover a change in a concrete reported consequence, separating narrative prevalence from complaint volume.
recurrence_shift
Investigate a temporal change in repeated or unresolved experiences and identify limits on its interpretation.
compound_association: process_consequence
Discover an association between a specific procedural experience and a distinct consequence in complaint narratives.
response_recurrence
Find a nontrivial relationship between an observable response and recurrence or persistence, inspecting discordant narratives.
barrier_behavior
Discover a relationship between an information barrier and a distinct consumer action; separate association from explanation.

group_difference: operating_context
Discover a population-dependent difference in a failure experience under a concrete operating context; do not infer vehicle incidence rates.
warning_gap
Find a disparity in observable warning or detectability experiences and assess vehicle-composition explanations.
repair_persistence
Discover a difference in recurrence or persistence following attempted remedy, supported by narrative evidence.
functional_impact
Find a non-obvious population difference in functional consequences rather than merely counting complaints.
adaptation_burden
Discover a difference in driver adaptation or workaround burdens and identify where the contrast stops generalizing.
temporal_change: experience_shift
Discover a meaningful shift in a specific reported failure experience and test vehicle-age or composition alternatives.
remedy_shift
Find a temporal change in reported remedy or recurrence experiences; select the date boundary and justify its interpretation.
context_shift
Discover a change in context-dependent functional consequences without treating complaint dates as failure incidence.
compound_association: context_consequence
Discover a relationship between an operating context and a distinct functional consequence; examine discordant reports.
warning_response
Find an association between a warning experience and a separate driver or service response, avoiding circular definitions.
remedy_recurrence
Discover a relationship between an attempted remedy and a separately defined persistence pattern without inferring treatment efficacy.
coupled_failures
Find two distinct reported experiences whose association suggests a useful investigation priority, not a proven mechanical cause.
